name: viralhunt
description: Discover trending/viral content across TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky, Douyin, Reddit, Mastodon, Tumblr, Hacker News and news RSS; learn the best time to post, top hashtags, trending sounds and the best communities for a topic; and schedule or publish posts to your connected social accounts via the ViralHunt.io API.
